funding_summary: The $589M+ in tracked legal tech funding signals an industry investing heavily in AI-native workflows. Harvey’s $15.5B valuation validates the enterprise legal AI thesis. For Team Counsel, the opportunity is three-fold: (1) advisory services for Indian enterprises adopting these tools, (2) fractional GC demand from GCCs whose parent companies use Harvey/Clio/Astra and need India-side legal alignment, and (3) CRaaS partnerships with well-funded CLM platforms like SpotDraft and Chamelio that need India market expertise. The DPDP compliance deadline creates a 216-day urgency window where every data fiduciary in India needs legal counsel.
